_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics dominate: no breaker in CVD/options skew/long-short/ETF flows, so skilled default is hold current Hope rung until fear_greed or momentum expands or rolls.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Hope phase; analyst explicitly HOLD, narrative silent on direction (defaults to same measured hold)
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds 55-70 and 30d momentum stays near 64 with funding flat
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks above 71 with momentum expanding, or crowded longs unwind and momentum rolls through 55
